Equation 15:
q_{s}=\frac{q_{s max}}{1+\frac{A}{K_{ia}}}\cdot\frac{S}{S+K_{s}}

Symbols (as printed -> plain name to use):
  q_{s}  ->  qs   (Max spec glucose uptake rate.)
  A  ->  A   (Extracellular acetate concentration.)
  S  ->  S_   (Substrate (glucose).)
  K_{ia}  ->  Kia   (Inhibition constant, inhibition of glucose uptake by acetate.)
  K_{s}  ->  Ks   (Affinity constant, substrate consumption.)
  q_{smax}  ->  qsmax   (Maximum specific glucose uptake rate.)
